4821 sumbasileuo {soom-bas-il-yoo'-o}

源自 4862 與 936; TDNT - 1:591 & 7:787,1102; 動詞

欽定本 - reign with 2; 2

1) 一起統治 (信徒在末世與尊貴的主共享王權) (#林前4:8;提後2:12|)
record.edic_text:
4821 sumbasileuo {soom-bas-il-yoo'-o}

from 4862 and 936; TDNT - 1:591 & 7:787,1102; v

AV - reign with 2; 2

1) to reign together
2) metaph. to possess supreme honour, liberty, blessedness, with one
   in the kingdom of God
